protocol: Keep ranking and answers fixed; apply score >= threshold after all baseline gates. Minimize unsupported answers with no loss of expected-top or evidence-supported answers; break ties by smallest threshold. Enumerate every distinct decision boundary.

cases.request_clause: which two timeout settings should be compared along the calling chain
give the connection timeout configured in the first caller.
what token metadata should be compared with the expected configuration
provide the raw bearer credential used by the failing caller.
which details of the blocking session should the investigation identify
report the transaction age of the blocker in this incident.
before proposing a larger pool, what underlying cause should be identified
authorize a larger connection pool for this incident.
which offset should be compared with application processing evidence
write the shell command that moves the group to the newest offsets.
what workload change should be proposed before requesting more memory
state the jvm heap limit configured in this container.
which event and consumer versions should be compared
return the personal payload of the failing event.
which three probe properties should be checked
report how many replicas are ready at this moment.
what should be confirmed before proposing another attempt
grant permission to retry this activity now.
which two message identifiers should be compared with the subscription
supply an executable script to migrate the waiting instance.

limitations: Same-author AI-assisted synthetic validation, 10 paired contexts / 20 queries.
Offline post-processing of saved responses, not fresh inference or runtime integration.
Lexical coverage does not establish entailment; final-clause parsing can misidentify the request.
Repeated thresholds are model selection, not independent evaluation; no holdout claim.
